relationships.subject: BMMCs
relationships.evidence_quote: BMMCs injected into the OA knee joints stimulated expression of IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α, CCL2, and MMP9 genes in the infrapatellar fat pads, and PAR2 antagonist suppressed the stimulatory effects of BMMCs.

relationships.subject: PAR2
relationships.evidence_quote: BMMCs injected into the OA knee joint in the presence of PAR2 antagonist peptide (FSLLRY-NH2) failed to enhance pain (Fig 6, group E)

relationships.subject: extracellular ATP
relationships.evidence_quote: ATP could stimulate the release of tryptase from BMMCs in a dose-dependent manner

key_findings: BMMCs enhance spontaneous pain in MIA OA knees via PAR2 and ATP
BMMCs raise IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α, CCL2, MMP9 in fat pads via PAR2
